rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Devices to Set Rents
rules.requirement: Landlords and property managers may not use or sell software/algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents or manage occupancy for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental units in San Francisco where algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data are sold or used to set rents or manage occupancy.
rules.penalty: Tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violations.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
